## Action

## Reasoning
The 500 ms latency is injected into each I/O by the FIS experiment, so more IOPS or throughput won't help. The healthy workload used only 1,000 of the 3,000 provisioned IOPS. Stopping the experiment only ends the fault injection: the volume, instance and template are not deleted. Nothing has been run yet; confirm with the owner first.
